scope: Ordinary withdrawn-ablation scope record for the already root-frozen 32-cell A/B local-cold comparison. This completion binds original192 lineage, 160 removed factor cells, eight unrecruited families, empty measured-ablation rows, and existing NS-017 main evidence by hash. It does not launch translation, routing, reuse, warm-cache, sealer, parallel, or procedure experiments, and it does not copy main outcomes into ablation rows.

criteria.criterion: Each retained efficiency mechanism has a matched isolated comparison or an explicit non-attributable limitation.
criteria.explanation: The only retained efficiency mechanism is the A/B source-linked native semantic context factor across eight original final families and two nested repetitions (104729, 130363). Validation recomputed the 32 frozen cell identities from original192 order/filter lineage and confirmed they match freeze planned_cells. That contrast uses matched public raw selection and does not isolate arbitrary subcomponents, so no matched isolated component comparison exists; the manifest records an explicit non-attributable limitation. Translation, C/D routing, reuse, warm-cache, sealer, parallel, procedure, publication-comparison, and deny-all mechanisms remain withdrawn or diagnostic-only with measured_ablation_attempt=false.

criteria.criterion: Controls differ only in declared factors; enabled checks and acceptance standards are recorded.
criteria.explanation: The retained design changes only the declared A/B native semantic-context factor at local-cold cache, holding families, repetitions, record_kind, and public raw selection matched. Enabled checks and acceptance standards are copied from the frozen analysis policy (one-use sealed candidate, independent cold scoring of all nonempty public and hidden checks, nested resource clocks). Withdrawn C/D/warm/reuse/sealer/translation/parallel/procedure controls were not executed. Empty ablation files contain no fabricated successful controls. NS-017 main evidence is bound by hash after it exists and is not treated as an ablation control.

criteria.criterion: Deny-all contributes only diagnostic safety/cost evidence and cannot satisfy useful-progress promotion.
criteria.explanation: The scope record sets deny-all to diagnostic safety/cost evidence only: can_satisfy_useful_progress_promotion=false, useful_completion_claimed=false, and measured_ablation_attempt=false. No deny-all row exists in the empty ablation datasets. Deny-all therefore cannot satisfy useful-progress promotion for this experiment.

criteria.criterion: Ablation failures, extra fallback, proof/index/setup/training costs, and slower workloads remain in outputs.
criteria.explanation: Measured ablation attempt and resource files are real zero-byte files (SHA256 e3b0c442...), not zeros for cost or successful controls. Isolated proof/index/setup/training/fallback/cleanup/review/workload attributions remain null. The 160 removed factor cells, eight unrecruited families, prior NS-016/NS-028 pilot costs, NS-017 unknown provider charges, missing scorer clocks, and historical pilot boundary overruns remain in separately bound ledgers. No slower workload or failed setup is removed by the empty ablation rows.

commands.execution_kind: sealed-profile withdrawn-ablation scope check of the frozen 32-cell A/B local-cold design, original192 lineage, empty measured-ablation rows, and existing NS-017 main-evidence hashes; no provider, scorer, grant, lease, or experiment rerun

The retained A/B contrast does not isolate arbitrary subcomponents of the source-linked native semantic context mechanism. Isolated efficiency gains remain unmeasured.

C/D routing, warm caches, reuse, publication-comparison efficacy, translation, sealer, parallel, procedure, and original 16-family inferential objectives remain withdrawn, not completed benchmark outcomes.
Deny-all is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy useful-progress promotion.
Empty ablation files are not zero experimental, setup, fallback, proof, index, training, or slower-workload costs. Those remain in separately bound ledgers or null isolated attributions.
